description: Use this only when the user asks you to answer a page's Inputs for them. Saves `data` to a collection the page declares, recorded as the signed-in user, on the latest version or the one given. Read the page with get_artifact first to learn the collection names and the fields it expects.

artifact.description: Artifact name, team/slug, or its link (a /v/N link pins that version)

collection.description: Collection name from the page's thing:inputs meta

data.description: Flat object of up to 64 string, number, boolean or null fields

team.description: Team slug when the artifact name is ambiguous

version.description: Version number; defaults to the latest

name: submit_artifact_response
